performanceDNA.actingMomentEn: spots the last empty seat with asymmetrical brows and pupils locked right
performanceDNA.actingMomentZh: 紧盯最后一个空座、高低眉微倾蓄势待发

performanceDNA.actingMomentEn: claims the seat in a zero-telegraph 90-degree sit with unchanging Chill (-_-) calm
performanceDNA.actingMomentZh: 毫无预兆90度刚性端坐、全程死鱼眼淡定免疫

stageTargets.descriptionEn: last empty teal commuter seat on the right

environmentEn: bright miniature subway carriage with smooth flat slate floor (zero raised circular Lego floor studs), teal commuter seat, steel-blue window band, and overhead amber strap handles
environmentZh: 明亮微缩地铁车厢，平整深灰无凸点地板（严禁乐高地面凸粒）、青绿色单人座位、冷蓝车窗带与琥珀色刚性吊环扶手

shots.beatIntent: Spotted the last empty teal seat while realizing rival Noob noticed it at the exact same instant
shots.beatIntentZh: 发现车厢最后一个青绿空座，同时察觉身旁对手Noob也刚盯上它
shots.audienceRead: Both commuters are about to sprint for that single open seat
shots.audienceReadZh: 下一秒两个人都会冲向这唯一空座

performance.reactionCause: heard rival Noob shift weight half a stud toward the open seat
performance.reactionCauseZh: 听见身旁Noob朝空座微挪了半步

shots.actionEn: Mo leans 8 degrees forward with feet still planted and aims its right solid 1x2x1 block arm toward the open teal seat on screen right while Noob edges half a stud closer
shots.actionZh: Mo双脚仍钉在原地、躯干前倾8度并抬起右侧1x2x1实心方柱手指向右侧青绿空座，身旁Noob悄然挪近半格
shots.faceEn: Mo shows wide shocked ring eyes (O_O) with pupils tracking the empty seat and asymmetrical eyebrows; Noob keeps Chill (-_-) eyes aimed toward the seat
shots.faceZh: Mo呈高低眉与震惊圆圈眼(O_O)且瞳孔死盯空座；Noob保持死鱼眼(-_-)瞄准空座
shots.cameraEn: Medium two-plane framing keeping the teal seat unoccluded on screen right, crisp push-in
shots.cameraZh: 保证右侧青绿空座完全无遮挡的中景双层构图，轻快推镜
shots.sfx: 地铁行驶低频声 + 清脆叮声
shots.caption: 早高峰最后一个空座！

shots.beatIntent: Mo commits full-tilt across the aisle thinking the seat is secured, unaware Noob has the shorter inside line
shots.beatIntentZh: Mo以为稳拿空座全力迈步冲刺，没意识到内侧Noob路线更近
shots.audienceRead: Mo is sprinting hard from the left, but Noob is already right beside the cushion
shots.audienceReadZh: Mo正发力狂奔，但内侧Noob已经贴近坐垫边缘

performance.reactionCause: carriage jolt triggers the race for the open cushion
performance.reactionCauseZh: 车厢轻微顿挫瞬间触发抢座冲刺

shots.actionEn: Mo sprints two stiff Motor6D strides across the smooth subway aisle toward the empty teal seat while Noob glides one calm step beside the cushion
shots.actionZh: 车厢微晃瞬间，Mo迈开两步干脆僵直的Motor6D方腿冲向青绿空座，内侧Noob淡定横移一步贴近坐垫
shots.faceEn: Mo has furrowed brows and focused eyes locked on the teal seat; Noob keeps unchanging deadpan (-_-) eyes
shots.faceZh: Mo压眉专注盯紧青绿空座；Noob全程保持毫无波澜的死鱼眼(-_-)
shots.cameraEn: Static carriage-relative medium-full shot across the aisle
shots.cameraZh: 横跨过道的车厢内固定中全景机位
shots.sfx: 车厢顿挫声 + 两声清脆塑料踏步声
shots.caption: 冲啊！这把稳了

shots.beatIntent: Noob claims the seat effortlessly half a beat before Mo arrives, stopping Mo dead in their tracks
shots.beatIntentZh: Noob抢先半拍毫无波澜落座，把冲到一半的Mo当场定在原地
shots.audienceRead: Seat stolen — Mo lost the race by half a step
shots.audienceReadZh: 空座被丝滑截胡，Mo只差半步当场石化

performance.reactionCause: Noob snapped into a 90-degree seated pose right on the teal cushion
performance.reactionCauseZh: Noob已呈90度刚性折角稳稳坐在青绿坐垫上

shots.actionEn: Noob drops squarely onto the teal seat in one rigid 90-degree R6 hip pivot while Mo stands frozen 10 degrees back beside the occupied seat
shots.actionZh: Noob做一次干净的90度R6刚性髋轴折弯稳稳抢先落座，旁边的Mo躯干刚性后仰10度僵在原地
shots.faceEn: unchanging deadpan Chill (-_-) decal on Noob; wide shocked O_O eyes with pupils locked on seated Noob and worried brows on Mo
shots.faceZh: Noob保持毫无波澜的死鱼眼(-_-)贴图；Mo呈八字委屈眉与震惊眼(O_O)死盯坐下的Noob
shots.cameraEn: Locked-off medium shot centered between recoiling Mo and seated Noob
shots.cameraZh: 聚焦后仰Mo与端坐Noob之间的固定中景机位
shots.caption: 黄皮新手：丝滑截胡

shots.beatIntent: Defeated Mo accepts fate as a dangling overhead strap commuter while side-eyeing the comfy rival
shots.beatIntentZh: 抢座失败的Mo认命挂上车顶吊环当塑料挂件，死鱼眼斜睨旁边安稳端坐的Noob
shots.audienceRead: Mo is literally hanging off the subway strap like a toy keychain next to the seated winner
shots.audienceReadZh: Mo像硬质塑料钥匙扣一样悬空挂在吊环上，与淡定端坐的Noob形成极致喜剧反差

performance.reactionCause: carriage sway swings suspended Mo gently beside seated Noob
performance.reactionCauseZh: 车厢轻晃带着悬空的Mo在端坐的Noob身旁摆动一次

shots.actionEn: suspended above the floor with its raised right solid 1x2x1 block hand docked flush beneath the overhead amber strap handle, Mo swings once by 8 degrees like a rigid plastic keychain beside seated Noob
shots.actionZh: 双脚离地悬空的Mo以高举的右侧1x2x1实心平头方柱手刚性贴合车顶琥珀吊环底面，像一枚硬质塑料钥匙扣一样整体轻摆8度，身旁Noob淡定端坐
shots.faceEn: Mo has deadpan (-_-) eyes shifted sideways toward Noob under asymmetrical brows; Noob holds flat Chill (-_-) decal forward
shots.faceZh: Mo以高低眉配死鱼眼(-_-)向右侧斜睨Noob；Noob继续正视前方保持平面死鱼眼(-_-)
shots.cameraEn: Locked-off medium-full two-shot showing overhead strap rail, flush hand-strap contact, and gap under Mo's feet
shots.cameraZh: 收入车顶吊环横杆、方手贴合点与Mo脚下悬空缝隙的固定双人中全景
shots.sfx: 黑胶急停 + 塑料挂件轻晃叮声
shots.caption: 喜提早高峰塑料挂件体验卡
